current.headline: Phase 19 in progress — interaction inventory underway; accessibility, incident, and signed-upload repairs documented
current.summary: Phase 18 (Ask Library) remains production-complete. Phase 19 has correlated and repaired the known worker failures, captured the landing contract, catalogued routes, added authenticated-route axe coverage, closed a signed-upload quota-bypass/data-integrity flaw, and is adding evidence-backed control interaction coverage across shared shell, Writer, and Library. Read-only production data checks found a small, explicit owner-authorized cleanup hold: eight unreferenced Storage objects and seven catalog rows. The remaining control/journey pass, VoiceOver, cleanup recheck, and owner confirmation remain open.
current.nextAction: Extend the started per-control interaction inventory and broader journeys, keep manual VoiceOver recorded as an agent limitation, obtain authorization to delete and recheck D-19-11's exact orphan set, then request owner confirmation before Phase 20 production-affecting work begins.

phases.title: Product-Wide Baseline, Contract Capture, and Defect Audit
phases.summary: Diagnose reported Render server failures, establish frontend tooling (with documented substitutes for the unreachable Stitch MCP and unavailable Uncodixify plugin), freeze the landing-page visual contract, audit every route/control, and populate the Phase 19-23 defect register. Interaction inventory is underway; signed-upload byte-accounting is repaired; exact existing Storage/catalog cleanup is awaiting owner authorization.
phases.confirmation: Not yet requested. Owner confirmation is required before Phase 20 production-affecting work begins per the plan's own gate.
evidence: Render deploy history (last 20 deploys, srv-d9dgiamrnols73ccpa10) shows no build_failed/update_failed/canceled deploy; no unresolved deploy-time failure exists.

One confirmed runtime crash (R-19-1, 2026-07-20T04:57:20Z, 'unsupported Unicode escape sequence' in pg-pool via pg-boss) diagnosed, repaired (packages/ingestion/src/sanitizeText.ts sanitizes text at the parseDocument boundary; apps/worker/src/index.ts adds uncaughtException/unhandledRejection observability), and regression-tested (5 new Vitest cases, 43/43 @ice/ingestion tests pass). See docs/incidents/render-server-failures-phase-19.md and docs/runbooks/render-worker-failure-response.md.

Stitch MCP checked live (list_projects/list_design_systems) and found non-functional ('Incompatible auth server: does not support dynamic client registration'); Uncodixify is not a resolvable plugin in this environment. Both substitutions documented in docs/audits/phase-19-frontend-tooling.md rather than silently skipped.

D-19-1: fixed a pre-existing, deterministic CI failure on main (ambiguous 'Theme' accessible name colliding with the header's quick toggle, e2e/workspace-shell.spec.ts) — also a genuine accessibility defect, not just a test artifact. Verified locally: the CI-safe 10-spec E2E subset (53 tests, 1 skipped) passes clean. Logged in docs/audits/phase-19-product-audit.md, the running defect register.

Landing-page visual contract frozen (plan 19.4): apps/web/e2e/landing-contract.spec.ts (4 toHaveScreenshot assertions) with Linux-flavored baselines generated via the official Playwright Docker image; docs/baselines/phase-19/ holds the PNG set plus landing-product-contract.md describing labels/hierarchy/tokens/responsive behavior.

docs/audits/phase-19-system-inventory.md catalogs all 20 page routes and 55 API routes with actual auth mechanism, and the 20 E2E spec files' CI-safe (11) vs manual-only (9) split. CI on main confirmed green again after D-19-1 (gh run list).

R-19-2 (production incident, found and fixed during this Phase 19 session): the worker crash-looped for ~3h42m (2026-07-22T01:11-04:53Z) on SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN inside pg-boss startup after a DB-credential rotation; fixed by parsing DATABASE_URL into discrete fields for pg-boss (packages/db/src/queue.ts buildPgBossConfig, commit 77b0502). Confirmed via render logs: 92 matching error lines in the window, zero after the fix deployed live at 04:53:59Z. Documentation backfilled as D-19-3 (the fix commits initially shipped without a project-log/incident-log update).

D-19-2: orphaned pg-boss extract-text/analyze-work jobs left behind by work-purge and E2E test teardown (pgboss.job has no FK to document) drain on worker boot and error-log “Document not found” for legitimately-deleted documents — found live during this audit (23 stale jobs drained). Fixed with cancelQueuedJobsForDocuments() wired into both delete paths; verified locally against Postgres and via the full e2e/trash.spec.ts suite.

D-19-4 (self-caught): D-19-2's own fix broke CI on landing (8/11 CI-safe specs failed, pgboss.job schema doesn't exist in a fresh CI Postgres since pg-boss creates it lazily). Fixed by tolerating Postgres error 42P01 on the nested DrizzleQueryError.cause; verified against a throwaway schema-less local database and confirmed CI run 29893829352 passed all 11 specs, with the Render worker redeploy independently confirmed healthy via logs (instance-ID-verified, not just a passing deploy status).

D-19-5: 3 manual-only E2E specs (annotations, reader, roadmap) still assumed the pre-Phase-14 upload flow (immediate redirect to /works/<id>), which Phase 14's batch-upload rewrite replaced with a status list requiring an explicit "Open work" click. Fixed with a shared uploadOneFileViaUI() helper in e2e/helpers.ts.

D-19-6: fixing D-19-5 surfaced that local dev's worker had silently defaulted to the legacy ANALYSIS_PIPELINE=v1 (production has run v2+ since Phase 8) -- set to v2 in apps/worker/.env to match production. This surfaced three further confirmed findings: Phase 11.5's default-view flip wasn't reflected in reader.spec.ts (fixed), v2's auto-ready confirm-skip wasn't handled (fixed via uploadAndConfirmViaUI()), and v2's full research pipeline now runs before the document is ever confirmable, making its real duration several minutes and live-network-bound -- confirmed live against the database (processing_run.stage='research-discovery' after 3+ minutes). Partially fixed: reader.spec.ts's non-upload-timing tests pass under v2; the two live-pipeline-timing-bound tests and annotations.spec.ts's legacy-panel dependency are left as an open, documented question rather than silently patched.

D-19-7: apps/web/.env.local never set any Phase 12/18 release flag (Writer, cross-library graph, interactive reader, library identity, RAG), all off by default but all configured in Vercel production. Worse, hardening.spec.ts's Writer accessibility test was passing anyway, since none of its assertions checked that real Writer content loaded -- it was scanning Next.js's own not-found page. Fixed by setting all 5 flags locally (gitignored, matches production) and adding a real-content assertion to hardening.spec.ts. Re-verified broadly: writer.spec.ts + hardening.spec.ts (3 tests), graph-expansion.spec.ts, and rag.spec.ts (previously silently skipped) all now pass genuinely; the full CI-safe subset went from 52 passed + 1 skipped to 53/53 passed, zero regressions.

D-19-8: added apps/web/e2e/accessibility-sweep.spec.ts covering 11 previously-unscanned authenticated routes (dashboard, upload, library, works list/detail, reader, roadmap, per-work Visualization, curriculum, diagnostic, global Visualization, trash, Ask Library) with real-content assertions plus wcag2a/wcag2aa axe scans. Ruled out two false positives (an onboarding-gate redirect fixture gap, and a transient CSS color-transition caught mid-flight by axe, not a real token bug) before reaching zero real violations across all 11 routes. Also fixed roadmap.spec.ts's stale 'Knowledge graph' heading assertion (Phase 11.8 renamed it to 'Visualization'). A 15-spec regression batch (CI-safe subset + hardening/writer/graph-expansion/rag/the new sweep) passes 70/70. Manual VoiceOver verification remains an explicitly recorded open item.

D-19-9: the documented local E2E command failed in a fresh shell because Playwright imported @ice/db before Next.js loaded gitignored env files. apps/web/package.json now uses Node 24 --env-file-if-exists for the local DB/web files, preserving CI's injected environment; the normal command now discovers/runs the local suites.

D-19-10: direct signed uploads trusted the browser-declared size and excluded active staging rows from quota totals, so a caller could store mismatched bytes under an understated 500 MB reservation. Init now reserves every document row; completion reads Storage metadata, rejects/removes a mismatch before enqueueing, and releases an objectless reservation on attempted completion. The new manual-only upload-integrity.spec.ts passes all three real-Storage regressions; CI keeps deterministic dummy-Storage upload.spec.ts.

D-19-11: read-only production checks found exact ledger parity (30 migrations), zero dangling graph endpoints, duplicate document paths, missing document/page-image objects, or stale jobs; they also found eight unreferenced documents-bucket objects (3,104,281 B) and seven unreferenced Google Books catalog rows. No production write was authorized; cleanup and anti-join recheck remain explicit owner action/Phase 20 work.

D-19-12: repeated Curriculum CI-safe E2E runs exposed a flaky global Route locator during Next streaming hydration: the visible selector and a transient hidden server segment both matched. Trace evidence showed no user-facing duplicate; scoping all five lookups to #main-content fixed the test. Post-fix, 20 runs pass with retries disabled.

D-19-13 through D-19-15: the first literal control-inventory tranche, documented in docs/audits/phase-19-interaction-inventory.md, reproduced and repaired three keyboard interaction failures: Writer's pointer-only sidebar resizer, command-palette focus escape/no restoration, and the non-modal mobile navigation overlay. New focused Writer/workspace-shell regressions pass 6/6 with web lint/typecheck; the inventory and broader journeys remain deliberately incomplete, and manual VoiceOver remains an explicit agent limitation.

D-19-16: Library's exclusive reading-status filter exposed a visual selected state only. A new CI-safe Library regression failed finding a labelled group/pressed All button; `LibraryView` now provides `role=group`/`aria-label` and `aria-pressed` tied to the filter state. The regression also exercises status, relationship, source-type, and title-sort behavior; full library.spec.ts passes 11/11.

D-19-17: ready-work action links surfaced an ambiguous accessible name: global and work-scoped Visualization both exposed exactly 'Visualization' despite different destinations. The local action now has the accessible name 'Visualization for [work title]' without changing visible copy. A new CI-safe trash/work-status journey clicks all ready-work routes and cancels a trash confirmation; full trash.spec.ts passes 4/4.
